monarchy.label: hereditary monarchy
monarchy.blurb: The crown passes from parent to eldest child, and the great houses hold their towns as fiefs.

merchant_republic.label: merchant republic
merchant_republic.blurb: The richest trading houses elect one of their own to rule for life, and buy the rest.

theocracy.label: theocracy
theocracy.blurb: The senior clergy choose the realm's ruler from among themselves, and the tithe is the law.

elective_crown.label: elective crown
elective_crown.blurb: When the ruler dies the town lords meet and choose the next, and every election is bought.

grievances.old_blood: House {house} ruled {realm} until {year} and has never forgotten it.
grievances.distance: {settlement} lies far from the seat; the crown's writs arrive late and are obeyed later.
